paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 7.12, with a 15.21 percent change from the prior close and a 12.84 percent change over a window of 21 sessions. The price is as of August 11, 2026. There have been 19 new news articles in the last 24 hours.

Recent news headlines include an agreement between Fermi and Hillcore Energy Capital to develop a 2.6-gigawatt power complex at Project Matador in Texas, as reported by marketscreener.com and other sources. Fermi Inc. saw its share price jump after officially bagging its first billion-dollar deal for its flagship development in Texas, according to Yahoo Finance.

There have been various SEC filings, including an 8-K form disclosing the appointment of new officers, an 8-K/A form regarding the resignation of director Miles Everson, and a Schedule 13G filing. There has been one Form 4 filing and no Form 144 filings.
